Other possibilities (e.g., stress cardiomyopathy or occult coronary dissection) are far less likely without supporting features (e.g., extreme emotional stress, female sex, apical ballooning on echo, or angiographic confirmation).

[DIAGNOSIS]  
Myocardial contusion
